verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents a range of APIs (HTTP, Pixel, Transformations, Audit Logs, Reverse ETL), so this axis applies, but nothing in the evidence shows API versioning or a published deprecation policy. The "publish versions" feature for transformations is versioning of user transformation code, not of the APIs, and earns no credit. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 on all candidate paths.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
